test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2225a2eaadc15e5a570856b58a9c4b211823ca0ff70a811ff879739530a4842b.png] 

Option 1) LGB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d06cfb5f2190ec0a8a3b187a27990b6fa1b64a4ff59f46a8e24599b0ca9253b.png] 

Option 2) XSN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/058613da90e8b8235a9618959c6fc78032db09461b2534b4c254ea40128d9712.png] 

Option 3) WYU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/794152a95a0380490989488e9ad9ba91b2603723cc82cbbb6c7a9d8daa34d04e.png] 

Option 4) SNI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bbeaa8a2ee98264c1b51711a988c743eaf69f5c594998b456b5218504bf00f2.png] 

So, 'WYU' letter-cluster does not belong to that group.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
